purpose: Teach public users and AI systems how GEODOMAS product families differ, what problems they solve, how they are selected, and where engineering/project verification begins.
global_rules: A dome geometry preset is not the same thing as a finished building product.
Product price is not the same thing as total project cost.
Frame, envelope, interior, foundation, logistics, installation and local construction work are separate scopes unless explicitly combined.
A catalog model is not automatically a permit-ready or site-verified project.
Geometry comes from GEODOMAS CALC/product sources; structural, thermal, legal and commercial claims require project-specific verification.

families.name: GLAMPING / HOSPITALITY DOMES
families.what_it_is: Residential and hospitality dome family for private leisure, premium rental, glamping parks and resorts.
families.how_it_differs: Optimized around guest/living experience, repeatable accommodation layouts and scalable resort operation rather than office facade or protective-roof logic.
source_advantages: one family covers private leisure through large premium residences
can scale from one unit to a resort/park
package ladder from basic dome to Comfort and GLAMPING PRO
verification_notes: exact model identity must match current product/CALC source
all-season performance depends on actual envelope, ventilation and project engineering

families.name: DOME HOMES / RESIDENCES
families.what_it_is: Permanent or seasonal dome homes and premium geodesic residences for private living, nature sites, homesteads and larger residential concepts.
families.how_it_differs: Starts from residential function, plot, planning, envelope comfort and permit path; not simply a larger glamping unit.
source_advantages: supports compact to premium residence concepts
can combine transparent and opaque/composite facade zones
verification_notes: marketing 10M/12M/15M narratives do not always map 1:1 to current CALC presets
do not substitute nearest diameter automatically

families.name: GLASS DOMES / OFFICES
families.what_it_is: Aluminium-glass geodesic building and facade family for studios, offices, HQ buildings, administrative domes and business campuses.
families.how_it_differs: The facade is an engineered aluminium-glass system; glass choice, solar control, sealing, internal floors, safety and building services are core project decisions.
source_advantages: can integrate independent multi-storey internal building logic
verification_notes: glass type, U-value, solar factor, safety build-up and facade performance are project-specific
multi-storey floor-to-shell interaction must be engineered

families.name: TRANSPARENT ROOFS / PROTECTIVE DOMES
families.what_it_is: Geodesic protective enclosure placed over a house, yard, terrace, modular complex, resort or large public/commercial zone.
families.how_it_differs: The covered object remains a separate building/project; the dome acts as a protective environmental layer rather than the primary interior building.
source_advantages: can create a buffered microclimate zone
available as portable PVC, double-layer or glass direction
verification_notes: use-case cards and current CALC preset diameters are not always identical
thermal savings and snow behavior must not be promised without project analysis

families.name: CONCRETE / SHOTCRETE DOMES
families.what_it_is: Concrete or shotcrete shell dome family for residential shells, landscape-integrated houses and larger concrete dome concepts.
best_for: special concrete structure after engineering study
families.how_it_differs: The load-bearing envelope is a monolithic shell system with waterproofing/drainage and, where designed, a green-roof/external landscape layer.
verification_notes: special bunkers/storage/large concrete structures are custom engineering, not standard residential presets
current Ø10 source revision has a known geometry conflict requiring resolution before exact lock

families.name: CRYSTAL DOME / MICRO PODS
families.what_it_is: Small-format approximately 7 m² dome capsule/pod family that can scale from one unit to Duo/Trio, Tree Village, Lakefront or micro-resort configurations.
families.how_it_differs: Much smaller and faster-format than a full GLAMP residence; designed as a repeatable capsule ecosystem with shared decks/services possible.
verification_notes: commercial baseline and lead times require current quotation confirmation

families.name: NATURAL / REED-CLAD DOME HOMES
families.what_it_is: Dome-home direction where natural reed cladding completes a layered residential envelope and integrates the building into the landscape.
families.how_it_differs: The architectural identity is driven by a layered sealed shell plus natural reed exterior, rather than exposed glass or membrane aesthetics.
source_advantages: can scale from one house to a coherent settlement
project_start: prepare engineering and local project documents
verification_notes: thermal, fire, moisture and durability performance depend on verified layer build-up and local design

families.name: MIRROR INFINITY DOME™
families.what_it_is: Dedicated immersive visitor-experience platform based on a specific geodesic dome, synchronized light/media control and operator business model.
families.how_it_differs: It is not sold as a generic dome shell; it is an experience/business platform with content, control, session flow and licensing logic.
source_advantages: same infrastructure can support multiple experience modes
operator receives a system rather than only a structure
content can change without rebuilding the dome
verification_notes: visitor capacity, operating hours, commercial projections and license terms must be confirmed in current offer/contract
do not substitute generic HOME/GLAZED geometry for the dedicated platform
